01.
Learned Counsel for the respondent seeks further time to file response to the bail application.
Needful shall be done by next date of hearing.

02. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner has submitted that co-accused in the case,
namely Chandan Chaturvedi, has already been granted anticipatory bail in terms of order dated 12 th of August 2025 passed by this Court in Bail Application No. 153 of 2025.
It is further submitted that investigation of the case stands completed.

However, in view of the interim order dated 12th of August 2025 passed by this Court in CRM (M) No. 459 of 2025, whereby presentation of the Final Challan has been stayed, the investigating agency has not been able to file the Final Report before the competent Court.

Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the petitioner has further submitted that the petitioner is in custody since 28th of June 2025, and the offence alleged carries a maximum punishment of imprisonment for seven years.

On these grounds, it has been contended that the Surya Kant Bajpai vs Union Territory Through on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102299524/
1 petitioner deserves to be enlarged on bail at this stage.

Srinagar.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the allegations made in the FIR, the petitioner and other co-accused projected themselves as operating a company under the name and style of M/s Motley Refinery Pvt Ltd., and induced the complainant to invest an amount of 6,21,000, on the assurance that food products would be supplied in return.
It is alleged that neither the promised food products were supplied nor the deposited money was returned to the complainant.

04. Having regard to the nature of the allegations made in the FIR, coupled with the fact that the offence alleged carries a maximum punishment of imprisonment of seven years and keeping in view the fact that co-accused has already been enlarged on bail, this Court is of the view that a prima facie case for grant of interim indulgence in favour of the petitioner is made out.

05. Accordingly, till the next date of hearing, and subject to objections from the other side, the petitioner is admitted to interim bail, subject to the following conditions:
01. that he shall furnish surety bond in the amount of Rs. 1.00 lakh to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer with a personal bound of the like amount to the satisfaction of the In-charge of the jail where the petitioner is presently lodged.
02.
that the petitioner shall not temper with the prosecution witness(s) and he shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer.
03. that the petitioner shall surrender his passport, if any, with the Investigating Officer and shall not leave the limits of the Country without prior permission of the Investigating Officer.
06. List this bail application along with Bail App No. 153/2025 on 17th of December, 2025.
(Sanjay Dhar) Judge SRINAGAR 05-12-2025
